title: Regression from T-RKZ-003: approval default 'ask' also asks for read-only connector tools — 8 adapters tests fail
description: Measured on luke/studio-setup 807303c: packages/adapters/src/executor-readonly-approval.test.ts → 8 failed / 16 passed ('allows ordinary reads without approval or automatic review', 'honors automatic review ask/error/pass despite a read-only hint', catalog true and false). Cause: T-RKZ-003 made the no-matching-rule default 'ask' (packages/core/src/action-approval.ts) and the read-only classification (READ_ONLY_CONNECTOR_PATTERN / readOnly hint / catalog metadata) no longer short-circuits to allow, and the automatic-review path is no longer reached for read-only connector tools. Required behaviour: keep the fail-closed default for consequential tools (shell, write_file, spawn_bot, schedule_create, unattended routine triggers), but read-only connector tools (get/list/read/search pattern or readOnly metadata) must still be allowed without approval AND still pass through automatic review when configured — i.e. the pre-T-003 expectations in executor-readonly-approval.test.ts must hold unchanged. Fix in packages/core/src/action-approval.ts (+ core tests); do not edit executor-readonly-approval.test.ts expectations. AC: pnpm --filter @rakazo/core test green; pnpm --filter @rakazo/adapters test green (only the 4 postgres files skipped) after 'pnpm --filter @rakazo/db generate'; T-RKZ-003 tests still pass.

context.text: fix(core): connector tools without rules reach auto-review; 8 -> 0 adapters failures, core 464/464; sha 90bcc89
